description:
Web-based server monitoring dashboard inspired by the computer terminals of Sevastopol Station from the Alien: Isolation universe.

🔗 Github: 
https://github.com/joaoandradegp-wq/Dashboard-Sevastolink/tree/Wallpaper_Engine

📊 Telemetry
The page reads plain text from the API, one KEY=VALUE per line:

CPU_USAGE=12.5
RAM_PERCENT=48.2
DISK_PERCENT=63.0
DISK_USED=210
DISK_TOTAL=500
SWAP_PERCENT=3.1
CPU_TEMP=51.0
LAN_IP=192.168.0.10
DOWNLOAD=1.25
UPLOAD=0.30

Bars and values change color (normal, warning, critical) according to the load, and the status pill shows ONLINE or LINK LOST depending on the connection.
title: SEVASTOLINK: A Real Server Dashboard
